Private Taxi & Chauffeur Service in AlUla

Private transportation for AlUla: airport transfers, hotels, attractions and intercity journeys.

Pre-booked cars for international visitors, couples, families and groups — from your ULH arrival to Hegra, Maraya and Elephant Rock, and on to Madinah, Riyadh or the Red Sea. One fare, agreed before you book.

The short answer

Taxi Saudi Arabia arranges private transport in AlUla through a vetted partner network: pre-booked transfers with meet & greet from AlUla International Airport (ULH, about 30 km from the resort area), hotel transfers, private drivers for multi-stop days at Hegra, the Old Town, Maraya and Elephant Rock, and intercity cars to Madinah, Riyadh, Jeddah, NEOM, AMAALA and Red Sea International Airport. Request a quote on this page or WhatsApp; the fare is agreed before you book, and we track your flight.

Arriving in AlUla

AlUla International Airport (ULH) is a small regional airport, and on-demand cars there are limited, so most visitors pre-book. Meet & greet is provided at arrivals, and a private car takes you to your hotel — about 30 km and ~30 min to the resort area. We track your flight, so a delay moves your pickup.

Getting to the sights

Hegra, Maraya, Elephant Rock and the Old Town — and how to reach each

Grouped by what you came for. Taxi Saudi Arabia provides the transport; guided sites are booked with Experience AlUla.

Heritage

The stone-age-to-Nabataean story of the oasis. These are the trips where timing to a guided slot matters most.

  • Hegra

    A drive out of town to the Hegra Visitor Centre, timed to your tour slot, with a return when it ends.

  • Dadan & Jabal Ikmah

    Usually combined on one outing; book the Experience AlUla access first, then fix the car around it.

  • AlUla Old Town

    A short drop-off from most resorts, and easy to add on the way back from Hegra.

Architecture & culture

Evening-led trips: the cars are needed at dusk and after dark, when pickups are hardest to improvise.

  • Maraya

    Hotel → Maraya for a concert or dinner, with a pre-agreed pickup after the event.

  • AlJadidah Arts District

    A short evening hop from a resort for galleries and dinner, with a timed return.

Nature

Sunset and photography stops — pair them with a heritage morning for a complete day.

  • Elephant Rock

    A sunset run from your hotel, with the car waiting for the return after dark.

  • Sharaan

    A longer outing; access and any off-road section are arranged through Experience AlUla, so book the experience first.

AlUla with the Red Sea

Combining AlUla with Shura Island, AMAALA and Red Sea International Airport

These are separate destinations. Red Sea International Airport is about 260 km from AlUla by road (~4 hr 25 min), so a private inter-destination transfer is usually a planned leg of the trip.

Private car or flight between the Red Sea and AlUla
 Private carFlight
Door to doorCar:Resort or hotel at one end to hotel at the other, one vehicleFlight:Airport to airport; a car is still needed at both ends
LuggageCar:One vehicle, no re-handlingFlight:Subject to airline allowance and schedule
TimingCar:You choose the departure timeFlight:Fixed schedule — check which airlines currently connect the two airports
Best forCar:Families, groups, golf or photo gear, travellers who want the landscapeFlight:Solo or light travellers when a suitable flight exists

Before you go

Practical notes for planning AlUla transport

Season

October to March is the main season, with daytime temperatures of roughly 15–25°C. Summer is very hot — plan outdoor stops for early morning and after sunset.

Book ahead

AlUla has a limited supply of cars and on-demand taxis at the airport are scarce, especially during festival weeks. Pre-book arrivals and event nights.

Guided sites

Hegra, Dadan, Jabal Ikmah and Sharaan are visited through Experience AlUla experiences. Book the experience first, then we fix the car around the slot.

Event nights

After concerts at Maraya everyone leaves at once. Agree a pickup point and time in advance.

Sunset

Elephant Rock is busiest around sunset. Arrive ahead of the light and ask the driver to wait for the return.

Long drives

Madinah is about ~3 hr away and the Red Sea coast about ~4 hr 25 min. Tell the driver your rest and prayer stops at the start.

FAQ

AlUla transport questions, answered

Short answers to what international visitors ask before booking.

Ask on WhatsApp

Is a private driver useful in AlUla?

Yes, if you plan more than one or two stops. AlUla's sites are spread across the valley and on-demand taxis are limited, so a private driver keeps one car with you for the whole day, waits at each stop and carries your bags.

How do I get from AlUla airport to my hotel?

Pre-book a private car from AlUla International Airport (ULH). It is about 30 km and ~30 min to the resort area. We track your flight, so a delay moves your pickup, and 15–30 minutes of waiting is free.

Can I arrange a private transfer before arriving?

Yes — that is the usual way. Send your flight number, hotel and passenger count by form or WhatsApp. The fare is agreed before you book and you receive driver details before pickup.

How do I visit several attractions in one day?

Book a private driver by the hour or for the day, and list the places you want. Hegra, Dadan and Jabal Ikmah are visited through Experience AlUla experiences, so book those slots first and we plan the drive times around them.

Can you take me to Hegra?

Yes — to the Hegra Visitor Centre, where Experience AlUla tours meet. Book the tour with them; we arrange the car there and back, timed to your slot. We provide transport only, not the tour.

How do I get home from a Maraya concert?

Agree a pickup time and point in advance. Because the audience leaves together, a pre-arranged car is much easier than finding one at closing.

Can I travel from AlUla to another Saudi city?

Yes. Madinah is about 330 km, Riyadh about 1050 km and Jeddah about 700 km by road, each as one private car with a fixed fare agreed before booking.

Can I travel from Red Sea resorts to AlUla?

Yes. Red Sea International Airport and AlUla are separate destinations about 260 km apart by road (~4 hr 25 min). We arrange the private transfer from RSI, or from a Red Sea resort, to your AlUla hotel — and the reverse. Treat it as a planned leg of the trip.

Is Shura Island or AMAALA part of AlUla?

No. Shura Island and AMAALA are on the Red Sea coast and AlUla is inland; they are separate destinations. Travellers combine them, which is why a private inter-destination transfer helps.

Is there a meet and greet at AlUla airport?

Yes. Meet & greet is provided at arrivals. Share your flight number when you book; we track the flight, so the driver is there when you land, and driver details reach you on WhatsApp before pickup.

Can I travel from AlUla to NEOM or AMAALA?

Yes. NEOM is about 400 km from AlUla by road (roughly 6 hours 45 minutes to the NEOM Bay Airport area) and AMAALA about 295 km as a planning estimate. Both are separate destinations, so we treat each as a planned private transfer with the fare agreed before booking. Some NEOM sites need access clearance, which you arrange in advance.

What should I provide when requesting a quote?

Pickup and drop-off, date and time, number of passengers and large bags, your flight number for airport trips, and the stops you want for a day with a driver. The vehicle category is chosen with you.

Can families travel with luggage?

Yes. Tell us the number of large cases and the ages of children, and we choose a full-size SUV or a van so everyone travels together.

What payment options are available, and can companies get invoices?

Cash to the driver or bank transfer, with an electronic receipt on request. Corporate invoicing can be arranged through our sister company.

Can I cancel or change a booking?

Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pickup, and changes to time or address can be made on WhatsApp.
